授業科目の概要.科目名称: 選鉱・リサイクル工学
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 前期集中 その他 その他
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Place 　Hokkaido
Course Instructor　Mayumi Ito
北海道大学で行われる共同資源工学専攻の講義である。
英語により講義を実施する。日本人学生も、詳細は英語の表記を確認すること。
Held by Hokkaido University.
This course outlines the principle of physical separation methods used in mineral processing and resources recycling first and then shows their equipment and process. Details of plants and potential usage of the separation methods are also introduced.
Students need to spent about five hours per week for assignments, preparation, and
lecture review.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
A
Knowledge and Understanding It is expected that conducting of the course work will enable you to obtain ability to explain fundamental knowledge of crushing and separation methods used in mineral processing and resource recycling
B
Skills and other attributes It is expected that conducting of the course work will enable you to obtain ability to evaluate of separation efficiency and to propose appropriate treatment flowchart.
